about: The activation manager of the server: it decides which characters and items of a level are awake. Its six radii are plain floats a mod can read and write: 40 and 45 m twice and 10 and 15 m; the two bytes at +0x38 and +0x39 keep everything awake when set.

evidence.says: the Toolkit EoCServer.dll exports the class esv::ActivationManager with its constructor and methods

the constructor (bg3_dx11.exe+0x41A33F0) stores 40.0 at +0xD0 and +0xD8, 45.0 at +0xD4 and +0xDC, 10.0 at +0xE0, 15.0 at +0xE4, the helper passed to it at +0xE8 and zero into the two bytes at +0x38; the per-character rule (bg3_dx11.exe+0x41A7070) tests the bytes at +0x38 and +0x39 after the flags of the character itself
